title: Fix localized contact filter control name in Contact Sync
summary: The Contact Sync page now uses the localized ContactTxt table caption in FilterPageBuilder.AddTable, SetView and GetView instead of a hardcoded English table name, so the contact filter can load correctly in other languages.
key_points: Three hardcoded English table name literals were replaced with the localized ContactTxt caption
Affects the FilterPageBuilder.AddTable, SetView and GetView calls on page 7100 Contact Sync
Matches the caption already used by the existing filter field calls
Port of an existing NAV fix with no schema or permission changes
